entities.name: Maria João Rodrigues
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria João Fernandes Rodrigues GOIH is a Portuguese academic and politician who served as Minister of Employment in Portugal and was a Member of the European Parliament. She was Vice-President of the Group of the Socialists and Democrats (S&D) from 2014 until 2019. Since 2022 she is the Chair of the Board of Re-Imagine Europa, think-tank located in Brussels and working closely to the European institutions.

entities.summary: Maria João Fernandes Rodrigues GOIH is a Portuguese academic and politician who served as Minister of Employment in Portugal and was a Member of the European Parliament. She was Vice-President of the Group of the Socialists and Democrats (S&D) from 2014 until 2019. Since 2022 she is the Chair of the Board of Re-Imagine Europa, think-tank located in Brussels and working closely to the European institutions.
